# PptxGenJS 3.12.0

`pptxgen.bundle.js` is the unmodified browser bundle of [PptxGenJS](https://github.com/gitbrent/PptxGenJS) 3.12.0 (MIT, see `LICENSE`),
which includes JSZip. The presentation loads it only when you press *Export PowerPoint* in the live-briefing panel, so the deck
still opens and runs offline without it.
